message.content:
{
 "summary": "The soda ash solution tank level (LIT-901) is falling fast, dropping by -17.4% over 60 minutes with the current level at 17.0%. The most likely cause is a dissolving system fault, an open or passing tank drain/flush valve, or a level transmitter fault.",
 "likely_causes": [
  "Dissolving system fault: soda ash or salt silo empty, feeder blocked, or make-up water valve closed.",
  "A drain or flush valve on the tank left open or passing.",
  "Level transmitter fault."
 ],
 "checks": [
  "Compare the level transmitter with the tank sight glass.",
  "Walk the tank bund for an open drain valve or leak.",
  "Check the silo level, the screw feeder and the make-up water valve of the dissolving system.",
  "Check the solution strength with the conductivity or density check before batches resume."
 ],
 "handover": "At 2026-10-05 10:51, LIT-901 was at 17.0% after raising a fast-falling level alarm at 10:36 with a rate of -17.4%. Verify the tank sight glass, bund for leaks or open drain valves, and check the dissolving system components per SOP-13.",
 "citations": [
  "SOP-13 13.3",
  "SOP-13 13.4",
  "SOP-13 13.2"
 ]
}
